parameters.prompt: Animate this exact upright bull demon as a clean game sprite walking IN PLACE. Preserve the reference's three-quarter left-facing view for every frame. Locked orthographic camera, unchanged scale, full body centered, fixed baseline, pure uniform bright green background. Slow heavy alternating bipedal steps: exactly two hoofed feet lift slightly, advance and plant alternately; bent knees and subtle opposing arm swing. Small natural torso bob, gentle mane and tail secondary motion. Repeat two complete identical walk cycles and return smoothly to the exact starting pose.
